page-parsed.eventDescription: One successfully parsed source page: $15 per 1,000 pages. This fee applies even when filters, duplicates, exclusions or monitoring leave no delivered rows. Failed requests and unrecognized responses are not charged. Separate delivered-product fee applies. No start fee; proxy and compute included. Work stops before a new page when maxTotalChargeUsd cannot cover a page plus one row.

product.eventDescription: One delivered product row: $2 per 1,000 rows. Row keys: id, title, price, price_text, currency, merchant, rating, delivery_text, source_url. Filtered, duplicate, unchanged and excluded rows have no row fee. Parsed pages are billed separately at $0.015 each, even with zero rows. No start fee; proxy and compute included. maxTotalChargeUsd is an Apify run option, not actor input.
